$comment: GOLD pipeline-prompt: the required inputs and expected output of the pt-classifier agent (UXP-530 / UXP-543). Hand-authored reference. The classifier is scored against docs/product-truth/classifier/eval.jsonl; this file shows the I/O contract one row exercises. See docs/product-truth/schemas/classifier-eval.schema.json for the output shape.
purpose: Given a plain-language feature request, decide which product-truth artifacts must be drafted (needs_flow / needs_mock_data / needs_mockup), derive the routing outcome, and name the target component + entities + add-vs-create decision, so the pipeline dispatches ONLY the authoring agents the request needs.

input.user_request: Add a stock badge (in stock / low / out) to each plant card.

store_context.note: The classifier reads the request only for the need booleans; component/entities/decision are grounded against the store's entity_registry and existing artifacts[].

expected_output.request: Add a stock badge (in stock / low / out) to each plant card.
expected_output.reason: A single UI component, not a journey. Needs a Mockup and Mock Data to show the states; no Flow.

outcome_derivation.$comment: outcome is a pure function of the three booleans (needs_flow, needs_mock_data, needs_mockup). The validator (OUTCOME_BY_COMBO) rejects any inconsistent row.

rules: Return exactly one boolean each for needs_flow / needs_mock_data / needs_mockup.
outcome MUST match the three booleans per outcome_derivation — never emit an inconsistent pair.
component MUST be a component id from docs/acceptance-criteria/index.yaml.
Every entity MUST be a member of index.json entity_registry (a typo is a hard failure, not a new entity).
decision is 'extend' when the store already holds a canonical artifact for the component+entities, else 'create'; when 'extend', name the artifact id in 'extends'.
A backend/API/job request with no screen is mock-data-only; a static screen with no records is mockup-only; a config/schema/docs change is none (straight to normal AC authoring).
